module_summary: 8-to-16 bit width converter: a toggling phase bit stores the first valid byte, then concatenates it with the second byte into a registered 16-bit word with valid pulse.

anchors.name: phz
anchors.why: Two-state phase toggled per valid byte: capture high byte or emit word.

anchors.name: hi_q
anchors.why: Holds first (high) byte until second byte arrives.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte valid; toggles phase and qualifies capture/emit.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input stream, captured as high byte or used as low byte.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Registered one-cycle pulse when a 16-bit word is assembled.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Registered 16-bit output word updated on second byte.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Second-byte valid: loads data_out and asserts valid_out.

anchors.name: arm_n
anchors.why: Active-low first-byte capture enable for high-byte register.

anchors.name: pk
anchors.why: Packed word: held high byte concatenated with current byte.

groups.name: phase_control
groups.description: Phase toggle deciding capture versus emit.

groups.name: pack_datapath
groups.description: High-byte holding register and concatenation into registered 16-bit output.
